description: Find geologic rock units from Macrostrat by location + age, by stratigraphic name, or by lithology. Provide lat+lng (optionally with age in millions of years, Ma), or a strat_name (e.g. "Hell Creek"), or a lith (e.g. "granite"). Returns units with formation/group, stratigraphic column, bottom/top ages (Ma) and time intervals, lithology, and max thickness. Keyless. North America and beyond.

age.description: Geologic age in millions of years (Ma). Optional; used with lat+lng.

lat.description: Latitude (decimal degrees). Must be paired with lng.

lng.description: Longitude (decimal degrees). Must be paired with lat.

strat_name.description: Stratigraphic name to match, e.g. "Hell Creek".

name: find_units
title: Find Units
